items: Apple TV: a Player tab when you swipe down while watching, to switch to the compatibility player in one press.
A channel that plays sound but no picture now says so and offers another feed, instead of staying blank.
Apple TV: smoother remote navigation in Live TV, Multiview, Now and Watch.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
